change_summary: Add Horizontal Pod Autoscaler to catalog-service targeting 65% CPU utilization, min 4 replicas, max 16 replicas. This replaces manual scaling during peak traffic.
diff_or_config:
--- a/k8s/catalog-service/hpa.yaml
+++ b/k8s/catalog-service/hpa.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
+kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
+metadata:
+  name: catalog-service-hpa
+  namespace: production
+spec:
+  scaleTargetRef:
+    apiVersion: apps/v1
+    kind: Deployment
+    name: catalog-service
+  minReplicas: 4
+  maxReplicas: 16
+  metrics:
+  - type: Resource
+    resource:
+      name: cpu
+      target:
+        type: Utilization
+        averageUtilization: 65
service_context: catalog-service serves product catalog API to web and mobile apps. Current steady-state: 6 pods. Peak: manually scaled to 12 pods for sales events. 8k RPM average, 25k RPM peak.
deployment_plan: Phased rollout: (1) Apply HPA to staging and run 2-hour load test simulating 3x traffic. (2) Apply HPA to prod cluster with minReplicas=4 matching current baseline during low-traffic window (Tuesday 2am UTC). (3) Monitor for 48 hours before next sale event.
rollback_plan: Rollback trigger: if p99 latency exceeds 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes or error rate exceeds 0.5% for 2 minutes, delete the HPA resource via 'kubectl delete hpa catalog-service-hpa -n production' which reverts to static replica count of 6.
observability_evidence: Grafana dashboard: grafana.internal/d/catalog-svc-perf (panels: pod count, CPU utilization, p99 latency, error rate, HPA scaling events). CloudWatch Container Insights enabled for EKS cluster. HPA events visible in kubectl describe hpa.
alerting_evidence: Existing alerts: catalog_p99_latency > 500ms (warning) and > 800ms (critical) via PagerDuty. New alert added: catalog_hpa_at_max_replicas fires if HPA reaches maxReplicas for >10min. Pod OOMKill alert unchanged.
owner_oncall_evidence: Owner: platform-engineering team. On-call: @platform-oncall PagerDuty rotation (primary + secondary). Escalation: platform-lead -> VP Engineering. Change author: Priya Mehta (platform-eng).
slo_reliability_impact: catalog-service SLO: 99.9% availability, p99 < 400ms. This change should improve SLO compliance during peak by auto-scaling. Risk: if HPA thrashes (rapid scale up/down), brief latency spikes possible. Error budget consumption: currently 12% used this quarter, acceptable risk.
blast_radius: catalog-service only (no downstream dependencies affected by replica count change). Minimum 4 replicas ensures no under-provisioning. Maximum 16 replicas bounded to prevent runaway cost.
validation_evidence: Load test in staging: simulated 30k RPM (3x peak) for 2 hours. HPA scaled from 4 to 11 replicas. p99 remained < 350ms. Scale-down took 5min after load drop. No OOMKills. kubectl diff confirms only HPA resource added.
